about: Effect registry for compose-runtime/2 (research/blockers-20261021/ATTACK.md Move 2; MOVE2-COMP.md). One identity template per system.op: the logical effect a call makes (SPEC-E section 1, 'one key per logical effect'), built from entity arguments only, never from the caller's trigger, event or emission time. It mirrors experiments/compose/capabilities.mjs identityOf (the grader-side definition); runtime2.test.mjs checks the mirror, so identityOf is the test oracle, not the source. One deliberate difference: the grader scopes identities per case, host keys are world-wide, so a notice about no entity (about null) has no identity here and keeps its caller's key. Template syntax: {arg} needs a string or number; {arg|x} writes x when the argument is null or missing. batch: the template is filled per item over the batch arguments plus the item. read: a read-only op (no effect, never re-keyed, outside the single-writer gate). money: informational.
